answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic relic minted via verifiable stake burning. Each registered node burns native assets where the nth replica requires an exponential stake burning cost scaled as O(2^n). Staking contracts weigh historical lineage, treating each ancestral proof like a seasoned walnut shell encasing state, while staking tiers decay like brittle yarrow if fraudulent identity proliferation occurs.
